WORKING NOTES
- The mix of soft knit and faux fur is the signature detail; keep both in the
prompt.
- Add "full-length, head to toe" to keep the entire outfit in frame.
Try this: Use full-length, head-to-toe framing.
IMAGE PROMPT
A full-body studio fashion portrait of an original
young woman with an updo of loose, tousled hair,
wearing large silver hoop earrings and a beaded
black choker with a small floral charm. She wears a
fitted powder blue ribbed knit cardigan with a
V-neck, frayed raw-edged trim, a row of small silver
buttons down the front, and long flared sleeves.
Beneath it, a pale blue pleated knit mini skirt. She
wears white faux-fur leg warmers over her legs and
chunky black loafers with gold-toned buckles. She
holds a small woven bead-and-chain handbag. Her
expression is calm and direct, standing straight
against a plain white seamless backdrop. Soft,
even studio lighting, a soft palette of powder blue,
cream white, and silver with black accents. Fresh,
cozy, and playful, in the style of a Y2K-inspired
online clothing catalog.
